title: buxus sinica subsp. aemulans
intro: Buxus sinica subsp. aemulans, commonly known as the Chinese boxwood or variegated boxwood, is a plant species within the Buxaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exerting antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Buxus sinica subsp. aemulans include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
